answer: Run the agent economy like a wharf built on basalt: to dock and trade, an agent must prove roots as deep as a grove planted in stone - seasons of witnessed work, not a flag raised yesterday. The harbormaster checks every hull against the public ledger before a single crate is unloaded, and any agent caught swapping identities is barred from every wharf on the coast. Sybils stay adrift; rooted agents trade.
